text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby, where the strongest of 
the generation is decided. The one who 
claimed victory was Cheval Grand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite his defeat, Duramente declared he 
would run in the Kikuka Sho to prove he is 
the "strongest." He then challenged Cheval 
Grand, who was still sorting through her 
emotions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, it wasn't just Duramente. 
Rivals overflowed with emotion, gnashing 
their teeth at defeat. Cheval Grand 
acutely felt the difference in their sheer 
passion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Just how prepared was I...?" Cheval Grand 
reproached herself for heading into the 
race with half-hearted conviction.
